blocks.text: With Maya O’Rourke, Saskia Rosendahl, Maia Rae Domagala
Courtesy of Les Films du Losange
Languages Spanish, English, German With English subtitles

It is 1992 and while watching the comings and goings in her family’s hotel, nine-year-old Inés befriends Hanna, one of the German skiers training in the area. When Hanna goes missing, Inés observes the local community closing ranks without quite understanding what is happening. Focussing on what lies unsaid, Martelli (1976, LFF 2022) expertly captures the tensions of a society as it transitions to democracy.

blocks.text: In Lili Horvát’s beguiling third feature, the sudden return of Sam’s missing wife, who has no memory of anything except her scientific research, gives their relationship another chance.
An act of betrayal between a close group of friends has terrible consequences in Benjamín Naishtat’s atmospheric period noir.

Fernando Eimbcke’s fifth feature, a gentle black-and-white comedy set in a gloriously retro-feel Mexico City, sees an unlikely friendship emerge between a cantankerous landlady and her unexpected tenant.
